scope: Remove only the trailing5s entry gate from code and model instructions. Fees, spread, slippage, long-only policy, fixed100USD and no-real-order boundary are unchanged. Default gated mode remains for control experiments; use --no-entry-cost-filter for the unfiltered live mode.

pairedReplay.selection: 40 equally spaced original request indices plus all8gate-eligible inputs. Enriched non-representative sample.
pairedReplay.limitations: No positions or fills are replayed. Account state stays the original flat account for each pair. No PnL is inferred. One response per arm/input does not fully separate prompt effects from model variability. Unchanged choices do not mean unchanged distributions.

liveSmoke.limitations: 60second end-to-end smoke test, not a profitability estimate or a matched-market comparison to the prior10minute run.

tests.tdd: Failing tests preceded unfiltered prompt generation and report support. Real accounting test verifies a buy on declining quotes, a later sell, both fees, adverse slippage and future-quote execution.
tests.review: Read-only code review found no actionable findings; warned not to interpret unchanged choices as unchanged probability distributions or evidence about profitability.
